author: caio_mendes
title: Where is the support the MEGA service?
content: Is a very good app in every way, but I did not give 5 stars to it because I felt lack the support MEGA service for downloads of music etc. If possible, in a future update of app Evermusic PRO, you guys could include the support for MEGA Service to downloads of musics etc.
